seo.metaDescription: Bring test management, low-code automation and AI root-cause analysis together with testoriumz continuous testing software. Explore a product demo.
seo.keywords: testoriumz, continuous testing, quality engineering, continuous testing software, low-code test automation, AI root-cause analysis for testing, CI/CD test automation, test management software

sections.title: testoriumz
sections.subtitle: Continuous quality engineering with low-code testing, AI root-cause analysis and CI/CD integration.

sections.heading: One platform for continuous testing
sections.body: testoriumz is for quality leaders and delivery teams working across a fragmented testing-tool estate. Linkfields’ quality engineering platform brings test management, low-code automation, root-cause analysis, dashboards and CI/CD integration together to support continuous testing.
sections.secondaryBody:
Evaluate the platform against a representative application and release workflow. Optional [quality engineering services](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) can support test design, automation and delivery adoption; a services engagement is not required to buy the software.

[Request a testoriumz demo](#get-in-touch) · [Browse products](/products-and-accelerators)

sections.heading: Plan, automate and investigate tests in one platform
sections.description: Evaluate the platform through test planning, automated execution, failure investigation and release reporting.

items.title: Test management
items.description: Organise test plans and execution results in one platform, giving quality teams a connected view of the testing needed for each release.

items.title: Low-code testing
items.description: Create reusable automated tests using low-code tools. Use a representative workflow to review authoring, reuse and maintenance.

items.title: AI root-cause analysis
items.description: Use AI-assisted analysis to investigate test failures. Review the failure evidence and the limits of the analysis with the quality team.

items.title: CI/CD integration
items.description: Connect automated execution to software delivery. Review the supported pipeline, execution environment and result handling for your estate.

items.title: Quality dashboards
items.description: Bring test results into quality reporting. Review the evidence your release owner needs and how the dashboards support that review.

sections.heading: A continuous-testing evaluation workflow
sections.description: Use this illustrative workflow to assess testoriumz against your release process. Agree application coverage and pipeline support before a pilot.

items.title: Assess and create
items.description: Select one application journey for a focused proof of concept. Plan the tests and create reusable automation for the agreed scope.

items.title: Execute and investigate
items.description: Review execution in a supported CI/CD pipeline. Walk through a failure and how AI root-cause analysis helps the team investigate it.

items.title: Review release evidence
items.description: Inspect dashboards and test results with the release owner. Agree coverage, acceptance criteria and the operating handover.

sections.heading: Example: checking a changing customer journey
sections.body:
A delivery team needs to check a customer journey as application code changes. In this illustrative use case, the team evaluates testoriumz for test planning, reusable low-code tests, pipeline execution and failure investigation.

Review test results and dashboards with the release owner to assess the evidence needed for the next release. Product functionality is distinct from optional Linkfields test design and quality-engineering services.
sections.secondaryBody:
[Visit testoriumz.com - product website](https://testoriumz.com) for the separate product destination. Use the local form to request an assisted demo around your delivery workflow; do not include credentials or confidential test data in an initial enquiry.

[AI Code Assurance](/solutions/ai-code-assurance) combines quality and security gates for AI-written change. [Modernisation & Programme Assurance](/solutions/modernisation-programme-assurance) addresses regression risk during application and platform change.

sections.heading: Enterprise fit and licensing
sections.description: Agree the supported estate, operating responsibilities and commercial scope before selecting testoriumz.

items.title: Deployment and integrations
items.description: Confirm the supported application types, enterprise systems and CI/CD connectors against your estate. Agree test execution and runner requirements, test-data dependencies and deployment options for the evaluation.

items.title: Security and responsibility
items.description: Review test-data handling, permissions, result access and retention. Establish who approves the quality gates and how AI analysis is reviewed; AI-assisted investigation does not replace the release decision.

items.title: Licence and optional services
items.description: Available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without Linkfields services. Confirm the licence basis, onboarding, product support and optional quality-engineering scope separately.

sections.note: Licence and subscription describe buying terms; they do not establish which hosting options are available. Confirm deployment, support and inclusion details for your scope.
